basis: Per-group, per-layer, per-KV-head centered PCA fitted only to the original native calibration prompt slots; no scaling or whitening
projection: mean + (x - mean) U_k U_k^T; FP32 projection, FP16 injection; K after native k_norm and before RoPE; no second k_norm
token_rule: Compress all original external prefix slots 1..N-2; keep native token0 anchor, last native readout and all generated KV unchanged; no token removal
sample_rule: Exact original PCA manifest: 8 calibration and 24 disjoint analysis prompts per task; same official lm-eval sample-log arguments
evaluation: Installed pinned lm_eval 0.4.12 HFLM likelihood/generate_until and official task filters/process_results; no chat template; batch_size=1; existing Full-Sync cache path
generation: Reuse exact logged request kwargs and unchanged parent HFLM defaults; do not override token limits or stops
metric_rule: Fresh task scores and full-vocabulary first-token KL relative to freshly reconstructed uncompressed native KV; task scores are not reused
